# Joash Koh, LMFT: EFT Couples & Individual Therapy in Brentwood & Nashville, TN

> Joash Koh is a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (Tennessee #1970) and ICEEFT Triple-Certified Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT) therapist. He offers couples therapy, marriage counseling, premarital and discernment counseling, and trauma-informed individual therapy via secure telehealth throughout Tennessee, including Brentwood, Nashville, Franklin, and statewide.

Joash is an EFT Supervisor Candidate, AAMFT Clinical Fellow, and Certified Clinical Trauma Professional (CCTP), and the originator of the Asymmetrical Repair Syndrome (ARS) clinical framework. His background as a former telecommunications RF engineer and pastoral counselor informs his work with high-achieving professionals and cross-cultural couples. All sessions are online.

## Services
- [Couples Therapy](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/couples-therapy): EFT couples therapy to break negative cycles, rebuild trust, and reconnect; for any stage including crisis and infidelity recovery.
- [Couples Counseling in Nashville](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/couples-therapy-nashville): EFT couples therapy for Nashville couples, online across Tennessee.
- [Discernment Counseling](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/discernment-counseling): A structured process for couples uncertain whether to repair the relationship or separate.
- [Premarital Counseling](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/premarital-counseling): Attachment-based preparation for a strong, lasting marriage.
- [Sex & Intimacy Therapy](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/sex-intimacy-therapy): Help with desire, connection, and intimacy within the relationship.
- [Individual Therapy](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/individual-therapy): Attachment-based individual therapy (EFIT) for anxiety, depression, grief, and trauma.
- [Trauma Therapy & Brainspotting](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/trauma-brainspotting): Body-based trauma healing with Brainspotting, integrated with EFT.
- [Parts Work & Family of Origin](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/parts-work-family-of-origin): Working with internal parts and early relational patterns.
- [Therapy Intensives](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/intensives): Half-day, full-day, and two-day concentrated EFT sessions.
- [Therapy for Professionals & Executives](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/high-achieving-professionals): For high-achieving clients whose success has cost them their closest relationship.
- [Hold Me Tight Retreats](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/hold-me-tight-retreats): Structured relationship-enrichment retreats based on EFT.
- [Cross-Cultural Counseling](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/cross-cultural-counseling): Multicultural and cross-cultural couples and individual therapy.

## Asymmetrical Repair Syndrome (ARS) framework
- [ARS overview](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/asymmetrical-repair-syndrome): Joash Koh's original clinical framework for the injury that forms when one partner carries all of a relationship's emotional repair.
- [ARS Part 1: When One Partner Carries the Relationship](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/ars-part-1): How the pattern forms.
- [ARS Part 2: The Clinical Picture](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/ars-part-2): How ARS shows up in the EFT room.
- [ARS Part 3: You're Not Crazy](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/ars-part-3): Naming and validating the experience.
- [ARS Part 4: Can ARS Be Healed?](https://www.therapybrentwood.com/ars-part-4): An honest prognosis and path forward.
